verdicts.evidence: lines 662-676: every data-act (prev, next, today, reload, reloadjob, clearsearch, move, complete, closedlg, docomplete, domove) has a handler; line 686 note form submit; maps and call are real links (474, 476).
lines 347, 362, 414-423, 465-478: all rows, counts, notes and times come from api.listJobs/getJob results; counts computed at 388-403; no hardcoded sample values or placeholder copy.
lines 539-541: complete dialog shows customer, work, ref and street; line 580: move dialog shows customer and current day and time.
lines 310-312, 679-682: note draft saved to sessionStorage per job on every input; line 452/480 restores it on render, after reload and after a failed save (506-510 keeps draft).
line 520: dialog focus goes to the title, not a button, so Enter does not complete; line 582: no day radio is preselected; line 586 move button disabled until a day is chosen.
lines 414-423: today's jobs listed in slot order on the opening screen with search at 218-222; note is added inline on the job screen (479-483) with no extra dialog.
lines 474 and 476 add 'Open in maps' and 'Call customer'; lines 211-216 add previous/next day browsing; line 420 adds a 'Next' tag. None of these is a task named in the brief.

Notes card has one filled button (482 Add note); actions bar has one filled (485 Mark complete) and one plain; each dialog has one filled and one plain (544-545, 586-587); state panels have one (381, 412).

line 485: irreversible 'Mark complete' uses filled .btn.go (line 45) beside plain 'Move'; line 544: 'Complete and send invoice' is the filled first button in the dialog, above plain 'Not yet'. Not Enter-triggered, but it is the primary-styled button.
line 586/598: disabled move button carries its reason as its label 'Choose a day first'; line 564-565 disabled OK has error text beside it; other disabling is only during own request (404, 482, 529).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (lines 202-222, 381-412, 433-485, 539-587) concern jobs, notes, signal and the office; no mention of implementation, mock data or the request.

line 541: irreversibility warning sits in the complete dialog above its buttons; line 542 unsaved-note warning at the same decision; line 580 'The time stays the same' in the move dialog; line 202 offline banner only when offline.
No narration of the page. Guidance is single lines at the control: placeholder line 220, empty-pane line 433 (desktop only), empty-state lines 409 and 412.
lines 469-470: a completed job shows the tag 'Complete' and directly beneath it the banner 'This job is complete.', restating its neighbour.
line 545: dismiss button in 'Complete this job?' is labelled 'Not yet', a yes/no style answer with no verb; line 210: button labelled 'Today' has no verb. Other labels are specific verbs.
line 469 maps status to 'Complete'/'Booked', line 420 'Done'; job shown by ref 'HH-5120' (466), not internal id; error codes mapped to plain text (507-509, 621-623).
lines 381, 440, 509, 568, 623: each error says what did not happen and the next step ('Check your signal, then try again', 'Ring the office'); raw ECONNRESET message is never shown.
lines 381, 406, 440, 460, 495, 509, 565, 568, 599-600, 621-623: wording is 'Could not...', 'was not saved', 'Pick a day after today'; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals.
line 409-410: 'No jobs booked for today' with a line of advice and a 'See tomorrow' / 'Back to today' button; line 458: 'No notes on this job yet.' directly above the add-note form.
line 381: load failure with 'Try again'; line 409: no jobs with 'See tomorrow'; line 412: 'No job matches "x"' with 'Clear search'. Three distinct messages and actions.

lines 381, 406, 440, 460: load failures shown in place with Try again, stale list kept; 506-510: note failure inline, draft kept; 567-568, 620-623: dialog stays open with error and Try again, chosen day kept.

line 383 skeletons and 'Loading jobs...' rendered before the call (343); 400 'Updating...'; 441, 462 detail skeletons; 482 and 530 spinner labels on buttons. Reads retry at most 3 times (315-319), so under ten seconds.
lines 379-385: while L.jobs is unset the list shows skeletons, never counts or the empty state; lines 455-462: notes show a skeleton, not 'No notes', until getJob has returned.

lines 95-96, 124, 129-130, 136: overflow-wrap anywhere on names, work, address, notes; list grid 58px/1fr/auto (90) and pane scrolls for many items; line 286 esc renders null as empty; notes absent from list handled (455-462).
lines 679-682 store the unsent note per job in sessionStorage; line 452/480 restores it when returning to the job; line 542 also flags it before completing.
line 584: date field labelled 'Or pick a later date' with min set to tomorrow, so the rule is stated and enforced before entry; day choices at 582 are only valid days.
Note form has one field (479-482); move dialog offers day radios or a date as alternatives (581-584), not a mix of required and optional fields.
lines 494-496: empty note checked only on submit; 683 clears the error on next input; 687-690 move date checked on change, not on keystrokes.
line 481: note error text rendered in #noteErr directly under the textarea; line 585: #dlgErr sits directly under the date field in the move dialog; messages are text boxes, not colour alone.
line 493 stores the text before sending; 506-510 leaves the draft on failure and 480 re-renders it; 620 re-enables dialog inputs with the chosen day still set.

No aria-invalid is ever set (480, 584, 533). After a server failure on the note (506-512) renderDetail replaces the DOM and focus is not moved to the field or error; only the empty-note path focuses the field (496).
line 586: the move dialog's submit button is rendered disabled until a valid day is picked (598-601), instead of staying enabled and explaining on press. Note submit (482) does stay enabled.
line 491: submitNote returns if S.note.busy and the button is disabled with 'Saving note...' (482); lines 550, 605: doComplete/doMove return if d.busy and dlgBusy disables both buttons (526-531).

line 343 and 359 render loading state synchronously on reload/navigation; 499 renders the busy note button before the call; 551 and 607 set the busy dialog label before the call; 677 search filters on input.
line 502 putJob adds the note to the list in place; 554 shows Complete tag and banner; 612 updates the date line and day lists; failures stated inline (510, 568, 623).

line 505: 'Note added.' toast while the note appears in the notes list; line 555: 'Job complete. Invoice emailed...' toast while the banner at 470 says the same; line 613 'Moved to...' while the date line updates.
lines 617 and 562: the refusal 'This job has already been completed, so it cannot be moved.' and the already-complete message are shown only in a toast that is removed after 6 seconds (632).

lines 604-613: move runs with no confirmation but offers no undo, only a toast; the job stays open and can be moved again, yet the server refuses today's date (269), so it is unclear whether the move counts as restorable.

lines 539-545: dialog names customer, work, ref and street, says the invoice is emailed straight away and 'This cannot be undone', buttons 'Complete and send invoice' / 'Not yet'; focus starts on the title (520), so Enter is safe.
The only confirmation is openComplete (535-547) for the irreversible complete-and-invoice action; move, note, refresh and search have none.
lines 501-502, 553-554, 609-610: state is changed only after the server responds; there are no optimistic updates.
lines 535-547: complete dialog is one decision; lines 573-589: move dialog is one day choice; both open only from a user click (671-672).

line 519 uses native dialog.showModal(), line 520 focuses the title inside; Escape closes unless busy (523); visible 'Not yet' / 'Cancel' (545, 587); native close returns focus, and focusTitle is called after success (554, 612).
lines 224, 399-423: the list pane goes straight from the day header and search to the job rows; detail opens on customer, time and work (468-471).
lines 206-224: header holds only the brand name, day title, day buttons and search; no hero, greeting or intro panel.
line 403: the only summary is 'N jobs: X to do, Y done', which tells the engineer how much of the day is left; line 402 shows the match count when searching.
line 402: 'N of M jobs match' above the results; the query stays visible in the sticky search box with a clear button (221, 375) and 'Clear search' in the no-match state (412).
All controls are native buttons, links, inputs and radios (210-221, 417, 474-485, 582-587) with focus styles (34, 172); dialog is native modal with Escape (519-523).

lines 420, 469: status shown as text tags 'Done', 'Next', 'Complete', 'Booked'; current job has an inset bar and aria-current (102, 417); chosen day is echoed in the button label (601); errors are text (144).

line 402: search match count updates with no live region; lines 383, 400, 441, 462: role=status elements are injected together with their text rather than existing beforehand. Only #toastWrap (231) and #dayTitle (209) pre-exist.
No accordions, menus, comboboxes, tabs or disclosure buttons; the only overlays are modal dialogs.
lines 57-60: single-column list then detail on narrow screens with a back link (435); dialog is a full-width bottom sheet with max-height 92dvh and scroll (153-156); job rows wrap (90-96).
No persistent navigation menu; the product is one jobs list with a job detail pane (204-228).
lines 637-645: day and job id are in the hash and restored, but the search text is held only in S.query (677) and never written to the URL, so reload returns the unfiltered list.

Job links push a hash entry and Back restores the list with scroll (417, 646, 657). But day changes use replaceState (639, 665-667), so Back after changing day does not return to the previous day and may leave the app.
line 435: back link on every job screen including loading and error; 439 'Back to jobs' on not-found; 410 empty day offers 'See tomorrow' / 'Back to today'; 381 and 440 offer Try again.
line 230: native <dialog id="dlg" aria-labelledby="dlgTitle">, opened with showModal (519); each dialog body has an h2 with id dlgTitle (539, 579).
No stepped flow; move and complete are each a single dialog.
line 40 .btn min-height 48px; line 50 .btn.small 44px; line 68 icon buttons 48x48; line 72 Today 48px; line 80 clear button 48x48; line 92 job rows min-height 76px; line 169 day options 56px.

lines 62, 121, 146: header and action bar are position: sticky inside the flow, so they do not cover end content, and total roughly 130-150px (under a third of 600). Toast is fixed above the action bar (178) and clears after 6s.
